name: mark
text:
#define ADD_MARK(ch_, beg_, end_, flags_)                               \
        do {                                                            \
            ADD_MARK_();                                                \
            mark->beg = (beg_);                                         \
            mark->end = (end_);                                         \
            mark->prev = -1;                                            \
            mark->next = -1;                                            \
            mark->ch = (char)(ch_);                                     \
            mark->flags = (flags_);                                     \
        } while(0)
